purpose: Four logo concepts for user selection; not installed or deployed.

concepts.name: 01 — Voice Shield
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a polished original logo exploration for "Victim Voice", a women's safety and support app starting in India and intended to grow globally. Brand values: agency, calm confidence, being heard, trustworthy companionship. Sophisticated, distinctive, warm and functional rather than a generic security-company logo. Use the app's existing visual language: deep plum #30253D, jade #2C6D5D, restrained coral #CB433C and warm ivory #FBF7F2. Flat vector-like artwork with precise curves and strong silhouettes, reproducible in one colour and legible at small app-icon sizes. Not an actual SVG file. Present ONE concept on a premium, uncluttered square ivory brand board: a large central symbol above the exact wordmark "Victim Voice", and a small bottom strip showing the SAME symbol as a rounded-square app icon and as a single-colour mark. Generous whitespace. Excellent custom-looking readable typography. No photography, phones, stock mockups, shadows, metallic effects, gradients, watermarks, invented slogans, flags, police insignia, medical crosses or stereotypical pink woman silhouettes. Text must be correctly spelled.
Concept direction: A memorable soft-edged protective emblem where a speech opening and a bold V are combined through negative space. An inviting open shield, not a police badge, not a padlock. Plum main silhouette with a small coral accent that suggests a voice emerging. Geometric rounded wordmark, confident and humane. Keep the symbol extremely simple: at most two integrated forms.
